entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you with your VeloFit products today?
I need to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and the order number, please?
It's for Amelia Vance. The order is VF88602.

Thank you, Amelia. I see your account here. Let me just pull up the details on that VeloBand... Okay. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
Preference, I guess. It's just not for me.
I understand. I'm showing the item was delivered on December 19th, which was 31 days ago. Is that correct?
I suppose. I've been a little busy. There was a family emergency.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Of course, I don't need any details, but I do need to understand the timeline for the return request.

Fine. My father had to have emergency surgery and was in the hospital for a couple of weeks. On top of that, my brother's military deployment got moved up unexpectedly. So, no, returning a sensor wasn't my top priority.

I completely understand, and thank you for sharing that. It sounds like a very stressful time. Let me just check the policy for you... Okay, yes. I see here that your item was delivered 31 days ago, and our standard return policy is 10 days. You're unfortunately outside the window for a full refund.
Oh. Fine, then. I was expecting a problem.

Not at all. I can process that for you right now. And I see here you're a VIP member with us, Amelia. To make this easier, I've waived the return shipping fee and I'll email you a prepaid label directly. Is the email on file still correct?
Yes, it is. A prepaid label is helpful. Thank you.

You're very welcome. The email is on its way now. Just print the label, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you again for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get easier for you and your family soon. Have a good day.
